# The defaults of the agentree-statusline plugin: every option a
# configuration file may set, with the value the plugin uses when no file
# sets it.
#
# The plugin reads this file at every run, and nothing else holds these
# values: a key missing here, one that is no option, or a value of the
# wrong type is an error, drawn where the status line or the band would be.
# The options' types, allowed values and documentation are in
# plugin/src/options_spec.ts and docs/options.md.
#
# To change a setting, write only that key in your own file,
# ~/.config/agentree-statusline/config.yaml (or a project's
# .config/agentree-statusline/config.yaml), such as
#
#   mark-spacing: false
#
# A key it does not set comes from here, and follows this file as it
# changes.  A key that is no option refuses the whole file, with a
# warning naming it.

# ── The usage source ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Where plan and quota figures come from: auto, native, none, off,
# claude-usage-tracker, anthropic-admin, experimental-claude-oauth, or
# cmd:PATH.
usage-source: auto
# A non-secret label that keeps cached readings for accounts apart.
account: work
# The UTC period of the organization reports: day, week or month.
account-period: day

# ── The grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Columns each grid row leaves blank at the right edge.  null
# follows rows.*.place: 5 when any row drawn live is "above", where
# Claude Code's [-] stands, else 2.
right-edge: null
# Columns and label parts left out, scope[.group[.metric]] with * for
# any one part (docs/options.md, "Hiding").
hide: []

# A blank between a mark and its value.
mark-spacing: true
# The digits after a decimal point as subscripts.
subscript-decimals: false

# ── The rows ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each row the plugin draws.  place: "above", in the band above the
# prompt, or "footer", under Claude Code's footer line; live: "never",
# "running" (while a turn runs) or "always"; transcript: whether a
# turn's end stamps it into the transcript.  A file may set any one
# field; the rest stay.
rows:
  # 🎤 drawn above the prompt while a turn runs, then left to the
  # receipt stamped in the transcript just above it.
  turn:      {place: above,  live: running, transcript: true}
  # 🧵 the main thread in the band's tree above the prompt, kept.
  agent:     {place: above,  live: always,  transcript: false}
  # 🎮 the root of the band's tree above the prompt, kept.
  session:   {place: above,  live: always,  transcript: false}
  # The 🔻🔖 line under the prompt and the receipt's 🔺🔖 line; its
  # place is always "footer" (it has no live row).
  tag:       {place: footer, live: never,   transcript: true}
  # The 💳 account; its transcript is always false.
  account:   {place: footer, live: always,  transcript: false}
  # The subagents, in the band's tree under the thread that started
  # each, kept while they run; their place is always "above", and their
  # transcript always true: the receipt of a turn that ran any stamps
  # them all under 🧵.
  subagents: {place: above,  live: always,  transcript: true}
# How many seconds a tree row that finished, a subagent or a background
# shell or Monitor, stays drawn where it stood, ended, its parents with
# it, before it goes.  Counted from when it finished; 0 drops it at
# once.
finished-within: 120
# A rule, ─ across the band, as the first row of the band above the
# prompt, in the session's /color, or the prompt box's border colour
# with none.
band-rule: true
# The order the plugins' rows stack in the band above the prompt, by
# plugin name: those named here first, in this order, then every other
# plugin's as Claude Code gave them; [] leaves them as they came.  A
# name no plugin draws under is passed over.  A file that sets it
# restates the whole list, since a list replaces this one whole:
# [other-plugin, agentree-statusline] to put another's row over
# this plugin's.  The rule above tops the band only while
# agentree-statusline is first.
band-order: [agentree-statusline]
# Where the 💳 account is drawn: "row", a row of its own where
# rows.account.place puts it, in its colours, or "tail", at the footer
# line's right end, plain and dim, whatever rows.account.place says.
account-place: row
# Ask api.anthropic.com for the plan's windows, the weekly Fable one
# among them, once a minute with the session's own credential, which
# Claude Code sets and the plugin never sees; drawn under usage-source
# "auto" over Claude Code's own reading.
plan-usage: true
# The other weekly windows on the 💳 row after 🦊, each where the usage
# source gives it: 🎼 seven_day_opus, 🎭 seven_day_sonnet, 🍳
# seven_day_omelette, 🔌 seven_day_oauth_apps, 🤝 seven_day_cowork.  A
# file may turn on one alone; the rest stay off.
weekly-windows: {opus: false, sonnet: false, omelette: false,
                 oauth_apps: false, cowork: false}
# The account's credits on the 💳 row (docs/options.md, "The credits").
# A condition is {field, op, value, unit}: field "balance" (unit "usd"
# or "percent"), "spent" ("usd") or "expiry" ("days", "hours",
# "minutes"); op "<", "<=", "=", "!=", ">=" or ">", quoted.
credits:
  place: account
  show:
    cloud:   [{field: balance, op: ">", value: 0, unit: usd}]
    promo:   [{field: balance, op: ">", value: 0, unit: usd}]
    prepaid: [{field: balance, op: "<=", value: 20, unit: usd},
              {field: expiry, op: "<", value: 7, unit: days}]
    extra:   [{field: spent, op: ">", value: 0, unit: usd}]
    passes:  []
  amber: [{field: expiry, op: "<", value: 7, unit: days},
          {field: balance, op: "<", value: 20, unit: percent}]
  red:   [{field: expiry, op: "<", value: 1, unit: days},
          {field: balance, op: "=", value: 0, unit: usd}]
  original: false
  command: null
# Draw the rows under the footer line into the blank row below it.
hint-tuck: false
# How many columns in Claude Code draws the footer line's container.
hint-inset: 2
# A debugging aid: the footer's tail as a ruler of column digits.
footer-ruler: false
# Draw a folded message from another agent as its task and first line.
agent-message-row: true
# Hide Claude Code's own agent panel row of each agent the band's tree
# draws; the row comes back while the band does not draw the agent.
agent-panel-dedupe: true
# Show a slow read as a toast as well as in the plugin's log.  Off: a toast
# takes the footer's line, and the 💳 at its right end under
# account-place "tail".
slow-toast: false
# How many start lines and receipts the plugin's store keeps.
starts-kept: 400
